unit.why: Genealogical footnotes on rabbinic families (tombstone text, lineage letters, approbations) that contain one narrative: Elijah revealed to R. Avraham Z"K and serving as sandak at his son's circumcision.

stories.start_quote: קבלה ביד זקני עירנו שנתגלה אליהו
stories.end_quote: של בנו הה״ק ר׳ דוד האבד״ק גראביוויטץ
stories.summary_en: A girl serving R. Avraham Z"K (d. 1760) at his night study sees an unseen guest beside him and serves two cups; he later marries her, and at their son's circumcision a mysterious poor man appears, is made sandak and vanishes: it was Elijah the prophet.
